record.title: Magnitude 7.2 earthquake hits Ica; tremors felt in Lima and Cusco
record.detail: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake struck with Ica worst affected, triggering avalanches (Daily Express).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Peru joins U.S.-led Shield of the Americas anti-drug coalition
record.detail: Peru agreed to join the Shield of the Americas after Secretary of State Rubio's visit (Reuters, Al Jazeera).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Risk of extraordinary coastal El Niño raised to 85%
record.detail: Climate authorities raised the probability of a strong coastal El Niño; UNICEF says about 3 million children live in high-risk zones (Yahoo, The Rio Times).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Nearly 2,000 trafficking cases in eight months
record.detail: Peru logged 1,994 human trafficking cases in 2026 while its anti-trafficking plan is 99% unfunded (Latin Times).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Record K198.8m frozen under proceeds of crime law
record.detail: Police, the Public Prosecutor and BPNG's FASU, via the ARROW working group, froze K198.8 million across multiple bank accounts in a multi-year fraud probe; Commissioner David Manning called it the largest amount ever frozen by police.
record.attribution: Police Commissioner David Manning via RPNGC

record.title: Police target 'Don't Care Gang' in Popondetta
record.detail: Commissioner David Manning said the self-styled 'Don't Care Gang' attacking communities around Bakubari village was a priority target and police would use Criminal Code and Counter-Terrorism Act powers against it.

record.title: 50+ Indonesian fishing boats reported in Fly River and Gulf waters
record.detail: Daru police reported more than 50 Indonesian fishing vessels in South Fly waters extending into Gulf Province (Fly River mouth, Bamu, Turama and Kikori rivers, Moon Passage), with crews allegedly stealing catches, destroying local nets and nearly attacking auxiliary police. The National Fisheries Authority was coordinating with the PNGDF to send a navy patrol boat.
record.agency: RPNGC (Daru police); National Fisheries Authority; PNGDF
record.attribution: Claims by Daru police as reported by NBC PNG

record.title: FATF places PNG on grey list
record.detail: FATF placed Papua New Guinea under increased monitoring after its Mexico City plenary; BPNG said NEC directed 23 agencies to implement the action plan, with a first progress update due September 2026.
record.agency: Bank of Papua New Guinea / FATF
record.attribution: BPNG Governor Elizabeth Genia and NCC co-chairs via BPNG

record.title: Three foreign vessels held for illegal fishing in Gulf waters
record.detail: The National Fisheries Authority, with patrol vessel Ilakini and security forces, apprehended three foreign vessels with 27 crew for illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing in Gulf waters; two were escorted to Port Moresby pending legal proceedings and the third sank in transit after its crew was taken off.
record.attribution: Per the National Fisheries Authority as reported by The National

record.title: NWS puts Jiwaka on drought alert, highlands on watch
record.detail: PNG National Weather Service placed Jiwaka on drought alert and Chimbu, Enga, Hela, NCD and Western Highlands on drought watch, expecting below-average rain in the highlands and Western Province.

record.title: TIPNG: prosecutions key to exiting grey list
record.detail: Transparency International PNG said the state's failure to prosecute money-laundering offenders is the main barrier to leaving the FATF grey list and urged quarterly progress reports on the 23 agencies.

record.title: Five killed in Goilala village violence; police gun stolen
record.detail: Five people including an auxiliary police officer were killed at Lio village over a compensation dispute, and a police firearm went missing; Central PPC Chief Inspector Joseph Salle said weather and roads hampered deployment.

record.title: 54 arrested in Upper Highlands firearms and terrorism sweep
record.detail: Police said coordinated operations made 54 arrests in Enga, Nipa, Jiwaka, Wapenamanda and elsewhere, including over destruction of Mabisanda Lutheran Rural Hospital, seizing M4/M16 rifles and charging under the Counter-Terrorism Act 2024 and Firearms Act.
record.attribution: Police Commissioner David Manning via RPNGC

record.title: GI-TOC: PNG laundering threat up to US$1.4bn a year
record.detail: Global Initiative estimated money-laundering threats at US$560 million to US$1.4 billion a year, citing logging, fisheries, gold smuggling (~US$34m/yr) and a reported US$3 million airport gold theft in February 2026, with fewer than five successful ML prosecutions in two decades.
record.srcname: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime

record.title: Severe TC Maila hits Bougainville and eastern PNG
record.detail: Tropical Cyclone Maila peaked at Category 5 on 8 April with sustained winds reported at 215 km/h while stalling over the Solomon Sea; at least 11 deaths were confirmed by 13 April and more than 10,000 people affected, with nearly 20,000 needing assistance in Bougainville; eight died in a single landslide at Asiko village, Central Bougainville.
record.agency: Tropical Cyclone Warning Centre Port Moresby
record.attribution: TCWC Port Moresby / Australian BoM data and PNG government statements via The Watchers

record.title: Lamarain landslide kills 10 in East New Britain
record.detail: A large deep-seated landslide triggered by TC Maila rainfall struck Lamarain in Inland Baining LLG, killing 10 people and injuring 18, with multiple other fresh failures nearby.
record.attribution: Landslide analysis by The Landslide Blog

record.title: Soldiers blockade roads near Murray Barracks
record.detail: A group of PNGDF soldiers set up roadblocks near Murray Barracks in protest over alleged recruitment nepotism and disciplinary charges against whistleblowers; PM Marape announced a two-week recruitment probe with an Australian officer taking part.
record.attribution: PM Marape and PNGDF statements via ABC

record.title: PNGDF imposes nationwide close camp
record.detail: Chief of Defence Rear Admiral Philip Polewara issued Directive No. 7 of 2026 imposing a one-month close camp on all PNGDF units, restricting barracks movement, military vehicle use and weapons distribution after the soldiers' protest.

record.title: PNG completes ratification of Pukpuk defence treaty with Australia
record.detail: The Australian High Commission marked an 'historic milestone' after PNG completed its domestic ratification of the PNG–Australia Mutual Defence Treaty (Pukpuk Treaty), signed on PNG's side by Foreign Minister Justin Tkatchenko; the treaty makes PNG Australia's first new ally in over 70 years. (Australian defence ministers later gave 8 July 2026 as its entry-into-force date.)
record.agency: Australian High Commission; PNG Department of Foreign Affairs
record.attribution: Statement by the Australian High Commission

record.title: UNAIDS: PNG HIV crisis deepening; K50m emergency fund
record.detail: UNAIDS said an estimated 2,700 infants in PNG acquired HIV in 2024 (about seven a day), infections have doubled since 2010, and only a quarter of pregnant women with HIV get treatment; the National Executive Council approved an emergency fund of K50 million (US$13.5 million) for HIV, TB and malaria. PNG covers only 30% of its HIV spending.
record.attribution: Estimates and funding figures per UNAIDS and the PNG government

record.title: Sambio village massacre kills 12 in Bulolo
record.detail: Twelve people were killed and six houses burned at Sambio village; after a two-month task force probe 27 men were arrested, 25 charged with 12 counts of wilful murder and two with arson, and four factory-made firearms seized.
record.attribution: Morobe PPC Chief Supt Samson Siguyaru via RPNGC

record.title: Court orders Kandep tribal ceasefire
record.detail: The National Court at Wabag ordered a binding ceasefire between two clans in Kandep, requiring weapons to be laid down and a peace agreement within 14 days; police and PNGDF were deployed to enforce it.
record.attribution: National Court order and Enga PPC via RPNGC

record.title: Laiagam compensation ceremony turns deadly
record.detail: A clan withdrew from a compensation exchange and opened fire, killing two; a retaliatory attack next morning killed a schoolboy. Enga PPC Chief Supt Steven Harris urged an end to payback killings.

record.title: Police debunk fake NCD water-outage emergency
record.detail: NCD/Central Commander Benjamin Turi said a viral message claiming an NCD state of emergency and 14-day water outage was false; police sent a team to the Sogeri water source to assess conditions amid the dry spell.

record.title: 20 Correctional Services officers arrested in Port Moresby
record.detail: Twenty CS personnel were arrested and charged with illegal firearm discharge, assault and threats after a confrontation spread from a CS barracks to a residence; Police Minister Sir John Pundari called it unacceptable.
record.attribution: Police Minister and Commissioner via RPNGC

record.title: Bougainville submits final independence position
record.detail: ABG President Ishmael Toroama handed Bougainville's Final Position Paper to the independent facilitator and PNG's Chief Secretary, proposing preparation until 1 Sept 2027, then self-government, and full independence by 2030.

record.title: Two boats capsize off Kokopo; 27 lost
record.detail: Two boats returning from Pangpang Island (Duke of York Islands) to Kokopo capsized in rough seas in St George's Channel; 27 people (14 children) were lost, 13 bodies recovered, and the search was called off on 14 August. Authorities then capped boats at 8-10 passengers with convoy departures.
record.place: St George's Channel, near Pigeon Island

record.title: Nembi Plateau tribal fight halted by police
record.detail: Fighting broke out between two council wards at Embi village, Nembi Plateau LLG; Southern Highlands PPC Chief Inspector Kelly Sombe said both sides agreed to lay down weapons and prepare peace talks. No deaths reported.

record.title: PNG and NZ sign 2026-2029 defence cooperation statement
record.detail: PNG Defence Minister Elias Kapavore and NZ Defence Minister Chris Penk signed a Statement of Intent on Defence Cooperation 2026-2029 in Port Moresby, covering defence dialogue, training, exercises and personnel exchanges, with maritime security among the challenges addressed.
record.agency: PNG Department of Defence; NZ Ministry of Defence
record.attribution: As reported by Islands Business (article gives 'Wednesday'; Wednesday was 22 July)

record.title: NDoH and WHO draft plan to fix persistent medicine gaps
record.detail: WHO said a 27-29 July consultation reviewed PNG's draft Medical Supplies Strategic Plan 2027-2031, meant to address persistent gaps in access to essential medicines and health commodities; the draft goes to National Department of Health review. No shortage figures were given.

record.title: Four killed in Yangoru payback murders
record.detail: Four people from Haripmo village were killed in a string of murders including a retaliatory double killing; police arrested four suspects, East Sepik PPC Supt Christopher Tamari said.

record.title: PNGX warns of fake Facebook pages pushing investment scams
record.detail: PNGX Markets, the national stock exchange, warned that fake Facebook pages impersonating the exchange and its staff were promoting bogus investment, crypto-training and financial courses and soliciting personal information and money.
record.srcname: Australia Papua New Guinea Business Council
record.attribution: Warning by PNGX Markets (market release of 3 August 2026), as reported by APNGBC

record.title: Pukpuk in force; pathway for PNG citizens to join Australian military
record.detail: Australian Defence Minister Richard Marles and PNG Defence Minister Elias Kapavore met in Port Moresby and agreed to develop a pathway for PNG citizens to join the Australian Defence Force, with a pilot targeted for 2027; the ministers said the Pukpuk Treaty entered into force on 8 July 2026.
record.agency: Australian Department of Defence; PNG Department of Defence
record.attribution: Joint statement per the Australian Defence Minister's office

record.title: Ex-UPNG bursar charged over system fraud
record.detail: NFACD said a former University of PNG bursar was arrested on a warrant over unauthorised access to university systems and fraudulent transfers totalling about K602,786, plus about K445,860 in losses from fraudulent student registrations.
record.attribution: NFACD Director Robert Volo via RPNGC

record.title: Western Highlands governor warns of severe dry season
record.detail: Governor Wai Rapa said the El Nino-linked dry season was 'on another scale', with the river supplying Mount Hagen's water drying up, and said the province lacked resources to cope.
record.attribution: Governor Wai Rapa via Asia Pacific Report

record.title: Cabinet releases drought funds; NCD and Gulf critical
record.detail: Minister Billy Joseph announced K10 million per province (PSIP) and K5 million per district (DSIP) for El Nino drought response; NCD and Gulf were rated extreme/critical and a dozen other provinces on severe alert.
record.attribution: Minister for Health and National Disaster Services via PNG Today

record.title: Three arrested over fake gold sales in Tari
record.detail: Hela police said suspects sold a fake 109 g gold piece for K202,000 and were intercepted trying to sell a 1,245.5 g fake piece valued at K2.31 million; the PPC warned millions of kina in counterfeit gold may be circulating in Porgera and other mining areas.
record.attribution: Hela PPC Inspector Arau Mairi via RPNGC

record.title: WHO polio committee keeps PNG listed as cVDPV2-infected
record.detail: The WHO Polio IHR Emergency Committee kept Papua New Guinea among states infected with circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 2, with the most recent detection on 13 October 2025 and the virus linked to 2024 transmission in Indonesia; no 2026 PNG detections were cited.
record.attribution: Statement of the 45th Polio IHR Emergency Committee (WHO)

record.title: Six OBT gang members charged near Nadzab
record.detail: A dawn operation at Ngarumutu near Nadzab detained 11 suspected members of the OBT group; six were charged with possessing homemade firearms, ammunition, offensive weapons and marijuana.

record.title: Kidnapping and murder of teen girl in Western Province
record.detail: Armed criminals kidnapped two teenage girls near Haiyafuli village, Mogulu; one was killed and the other held at gunpoint, and one offender was killed in the police response, Commissioner David Manning said.

record.title: HPV vaccination to start for 60,000 girls in NCD and Central
record.detail: The National Department of Health announced HPV vaccination for girls aged 9-14, with about 60,000 eligible in phase 1 (NCD and Central Province) starting November 2026; WHO says over 1,000 women are diagnosed with cervical cancer and about 650 die each year in PNG.
record.place: National Capital District and Central Province
record.agency: National Department of Health; WHO; UNICEF; Gavi

record.title: Police raid Port Moresby scam house: 39 Indonesians freed, 4 Chinese held
record.detail: RPNGC's Transnational Crime Directorate raided a three-bedroom house in Port Moresby where 39 Indonesian nationals were allegedly held and forced to run online scams on computers; four Chinese nationals were detained, and Deputy Commissioner Donald Yamasombi said they may be linked to a wider trafficking syndicate between South-East Asia and the Pacific, with charges being prepared.
record.attribution: Per RPNGC as reported by ABC; raid day (Tuesday 22 September) per PNG Today

record.title: Immigration minister orders taskforce, deportations after scam-house find
record.detail: Immigration and Border Security Minister William Bando ordered a special taskforce, visa cancellation and deportation of foreign nationals linked to trafficking, re-entry bans, tighter border controls and a full review of the Immigration Act 1978 after the Port Moresby discovery.
record.agency: Immigration and Citizenship Authority; Ministry of Immigration and Border Security
record.attribution: Statement by the Immigration Minister as reported by PNG Today

record.title: PCG vows no water cannon retaliation amid China pressure
record.detail: Year-opening review cited repeated 2025 China Coast Guard water cannon attacks and research vessel intrusions; PCG said it would not use water cannon to avoid escalation.
record.attribution: PCG Commodore Jay Tarriela via Philstar

record.title: Motorbanca capsizes in Davao Gulf; 5 bodies found, 10 missing
record.detail: PCG Southeastern Mindanao said a recreational boat with 16 aboard capsized off Sarangani, Davao Occidental; 1 rescued.

record.title: Ambush kills 4 soldiers in Munai
record.detail: Authorities said Dawlah Islamiya-Maute members ambushed troops in Barangay Lininding, killing four soldiers (reported in April follow-up).

record.title: Ro-ro ferry sinks off Basilan, 18 dead
record.detail: M/V Trisha Kirstin 3 (Zamboanga-Jolo) with 332 aboard sank near Baluk-Baluk Island; over 200 rescued, 18 reported dead initially.
record.attribution: PCG and local officials via PNA

record.title: Off-duty soldier shot dead in Pagayawan
record.detail: An off-duty 55th IB corporal was shot dead on his motorcycle by gunmen suspected to be Dawlah Islamiya remnants.

record.title: Catanduanes floods: 1 dead, Bato River overflows
record.detail: Shear-line rains flooded several towns; a man was swept away in Virac and the provincial government ordered mandatory evacuation.
record.place: Bato, Virac, San Miguel, Viga, Bagamanoc

record.title: 24 Filipinos forced into Cambodia scam work repatriated
record.detail: BI said 24 Filipinos forced to run romance-crypto and fake casino scams in Cambodia returned via Phnom Penh flight.
record.attribution: BI Commissioner Joel Anthony Viado via Philstar

record.title: AMLC: 53% of suspicious inbound remittances tied to child exploitation
record.detail: AMLC threat assessment found 155,600 suspicious inbound remittances (PHP3.42 billion) in 2021-mid 2024, 53% by volume linked to child exploitation.

record.title: Kanlaon Volcano explosive eruption
record.detail: PHIVOLCS reported a 2-minute eruption with 2,000 m plume and pyroclastic currents on upper slopes; Alert Level 2 kept, 4-km danger zone.

record.title: Shear-line floods force evacuation in Bislig
record.detail: Bislig CDRRMO evacuated 2,054 people from 19 barangays due to shear-line flooding.

record.title: PHP6.6B shabu lab in Valenzuela warehouse
record.detail: PDEA seized about 906 kg shabu and 64 L liquid meth worth PHP6.6 billion in a Valenzuela warehouse; no arrests on site, suspects identified.

record.title: 12 Koreans arrested at suspected Angeles scam hub
record.detail: BI raided a suspected scam office on Poinsettia Street, arresting 12 Korean nationals incl. 3 fugitives; setup appeared to target Korean victims.

record.title: Rabies cases down 65% in early 2026
record.detail: DOH reported 17 rabies cases from Jan 4 to Feb 21, 2026, against 49 a year earlier; it said 13 were caused by unvaccinated animals. Health Secretary Ted Herbosa warned mortality is almost 100% once symptoms start.

record.title: 800 kg marijuana from Thailand seized at Manila port
record.detail: Customs and anti-narcotics agents seized 800 kg of marijuana worth PHP1.2 billion at Manila International Container Port; a broker representative held. Separately PDEA seized 20.5 kg shabu in Quezon City.
record.attribution: BOC Commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno via Philstar

record.title: Chinese vessels drive Filipino fishers from Scarborough
record.detail: Filipino fishermen reported being driven from Scarborough Shoal by Chinese vessels; the PCG flew a maritime domain awareness flight and reported its aircraft was challenged by Chinese ships.
record.attribution: PCG and fishermen via Daily Tribune

record.title: CIDG raids 24/7 e-sabong hub in Tondo, 172 held
record.detail: CIDG-NCR raided an illegal online cockfighting operation at a Tondo coliseum; 172 held (40 staff detained); police estimated about PHP300,000 in bets per fight.

record.title: Army officer killed in Occidental Mindoro NPA clash
record.detail: Army's 203rd IB said an officer was killed and 2 soldiers wounded in a 20-minute clash with about 15 NPA members; one rebel arrested.

record.title: Measles-rubella cases up 45% in Q1
record.detail: DOH reported 1,627 measles-rubella cases from Jan 4 to Mar 21, 2026 (vs 1,121 a year earlier), about 68% unvaccinated, and one measles death in Quezon City. BARMM (344) and Soccsksargen (322) led regions.

record.title: Flares fired near PCG plane over Mischief Reef
record.detail: PCG said at least 3 flares were fired from Chinese-occupied features as its civilian plane passed within 3 nm of Mischief Reef, hours after activating a Coast Guard District at Pag-asa Island.

record.title: 10 Dawlah Islamiya-Maute members killed in Marantao
record.detail: Police and Army said 10 DI-Maute members incl. leader were killed while serving warrants; authorities linked them to the 23 Jan Munai ambush that killed 4 soldiers.

record.title: Two Japanese fugitives arrested in Metro Manila
record.detail: PAOCC, BI and PNP arrested two Japanese fugitives linked to the Luffy group and JP Dragon syndicate in Mandaluyong and Manila for deportation.

record.title: NBI raids Paranaque love-scam hub, 48 arrested
record.detail: NBI Special Action Unit arrested 41 Filipino women and 7 foreigners running romance, pig-butchering and crypto scams from a condominium.

record.title: 19 NPA rebels killed in Toboso clash
record.detail: Army's 79th IB said 19 suspected NPA members of the Northern Negros Front were killed in clashes starting 18-19 April; about 366 residents displaced.

record.title: Balikatan 2026 exercise: 17,000 troops from 7 countries
record.detail: AFP said Balikatan would run 20 April to 8 May with over 17,000 troops from the Philippines, US, Australia, Japan, Canada, France and New Zealand; Japan to fire Type 88 missile in live fire.

record.title: Bus plunges into ravine in Pagbilao, 2 dead, 37 hurt
record.detail: A Daet-Manila bus reportedly lost control after engine trouble on the diversion road and fell into a ravine.

record.title: Pre-dawn house fire kills 6 in Urdaneta
record.detail: A fire that started around 02:00 in the kitchen of one of two houses in Barangay Nancayasan killed six people, including two minors and an elderly person, and destroyed both homes.

record.title: Freeze order on sitting lawmaker's assets in flood-control probe
record.detail: AMLC said the Court of Appeals froze bank accounts, insurance policies and property of an unnamed sitting legislator, an associate and a corporation over alleged ghost flood-control projects.

record.title: 2 NPA rebels killed in Motiong, Samar clash
record.detail: Army's 8th ID said two rebels were killed and left by comrades in Barangay Caulayanan; weapons recovered; earlier clashes 16-17 April in Jiabong.

record.title: PAGASA: danger-level heat index in 7 areas
record.detail: PAGASA forecast danger-level heat indices of 42-43C on April 30 in seven areas, highest at Sangley Point (Cavite City) and Aborlan (Palawan), and advised precautions against heat stress.

record.title: Kaliwet Bailey detour bridge collapses under overloaded truck
record.detail: DPWH said a 20-ton truck exceeding the 5-ton limit collapsed the detour bridge; temporary bridge deployed.

record.title: Shellfish ban extended to Daram, Samar waters
record.detail: BFAR said lab tests confirmed toxic red tide in Daram's coastal waters, adding it to shellfish bans in Matarinao Bay (Eastern Samar), Dumanquilas Bay, Bolinao and Anda (Pangasinan) and Tantangan Bay. Gathering, selling and eating shellfish and alamang from these waters is prohibited.
record.agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources

record.title: Red alert and rotating brownouts on Luzon, Visayas grids
record.detail: NGCP raised red alerts after two 500-kV lines to Ilijan tripped; Luzon short 413 MW; rotating brownouts hit 200,000+ customers in Metro Manila and nearby provinces.

record.title: 25 trafficked from Myanmar KK Park scam hub return; recruiter held
record.detail: NBI said 25 Filipinos trafficked to KK Park in Myawaddy, Myanmar, where they were coerced into online fraud, were repatriated via NAIA; a female recruiter who offered PHP50,000-a-month jobs via Telegram and WhatsApp was arrested and charged under the Anti-Trafficking law.

record.title: 5 NPA remnants killed in Cauayan encounter
record.detail: Army's 15th IB said 5 NPA members were killed in three gunbattles; M60 and rifles recovered; about 180 families evacuated.

record.title: Danger-level heat index in 44 areas, up to 44C
record.detail: PAGASA forecast danger-level heat index in 44 areas, peaking at 44C in 8 stations incl. Munoz, Sangley Point and Butuan.

record.title: 63 arrested in Pasig online investment scam raid
record.detail: PNP-ACG with DOJ, PAOCC and SEC raided an online investment scam using a fake trading platform in Barangay San Antonio.

record.title: PHP136M shabu seized in Naga City, Cebu buy-bust
record.detail: PDEA-7 with PCG, Navy and PNP seized 20 packs of shabu worth PHP136 million and arrested two.

record.title: Damaged Maynilad pipe cuts water in Manila and Cavite
record.detail: A 750-mm Maynilad line in Ermita was damaged by a city contractor, interrupting supply in Manila, Paranaque, Las Pinas, Pasay and several Cavite towns.

record.title: Two buses and SUV collide on Marcos Highway, 1 dead, 90+ hurt
record.detail: A bus that lost its brakes hit another bus and an SUV in Tuba, Benguet; LTFRB suspended 26 buses of the operator.

record.title: NBI raids abusive collection agency in Quezon City
record.detail: NBI arrested 26 people at an unlicensed collection firm whose staff allegedly impersonated officials to coerce debtors into paying again; NBI estimated commissions of about PHP36 million a month.

record.title: PAGASA declares rainy season onset
record.detail: PAGASA declared the rainy season over western Luzon and Visayas, noting looming El Nino could enhance habagat rains in the west.

record.title: M7.8 offshore Sarangani earthquake with tsunami
record.detail: PHIVOLCS: Mw 7.8, depth 33 km, 32 km W of Maasim; Intensity VII in General Santos; ~1 m tsunami at Kiamba and Maasim.

record.title: Quake knocks out power to ~864,000 Mindanao households
record.detail: After the M7.8 quake, about 864,000 households in South Cotabato, Sarangani, Sultan Kudarat and Davao lost power; DOE activated its energy resiliency task force.
record.place: South Cotabato, Sarangani, Sultan Kudarat, Davao

record.title: General Santos airport shut after quake
record.detail: CAAP suspended operations at General Santos International Airport via NOTAM 08:45-15:00 for facility assessment.

record.title: 22 trafficking victims return from Cambodia
record.detail: DMW said 22 Filipinos rescued from human trafficking in Cambodia arrived at NAIA Terminal 1 from Phnom Penh.

record.title: PDEA May 2026 tally: PHP1.95B drugs, 3,702 arrests
record.detail: PDEA reported PHP1.95 billion in drugs seized and 3,702 arrested in 2,941 May operations, incl. 5 elected officials.

record.title: BI raids suspected love-scam hub in Paranaque condo
record.detail: Bureau of Immigration agents arrested five foreign nationals (Chinese, Malaysian and Burmese) at a condominium complex in Paranaque linked to a crypto love-scam operation where workers were reportedly restricted from leaving; they face deportation proceedings.

record.title: AMLC risk assessment rates tax crimes a high ML threat
record.detail: AMLC's third National Risk Assessment said tax evasion proceeds move via shell companies, false invoicing and real estate; drug-related STRs 2021-2024 totalled PHP25.09 billion.

record.title: DOH: 44 mpox cases in 2026, no outbreak
record.detail: DOH reported 44 mpox cases from Jan 4 to Jun 13, 2026, 79% below the same period of 2025; spokesperson Albert Domingo said there was no outbreak or increase.

record.title: Sarangani quake toll reaches 88 dead
record.detail: NDRRMC reported 88 dead (9 confirmed), 1,316 injured, 24 missing, 1.68 million people affected and 113,279 houses damaged across Regions 9, 11, 12 and BARMM.

record.title: Iloilo confirms first ASF case of 2026
record.detail: The Iloilo provincial veterinarian reported African swine fever in a sow and four pigs at a backyard farm in Barotac Viejo; the office said the animals were disposed of, the site disinfected and checkpoints tightened, with no suspected cases in the surrounding community.

record.title: Kanlaon eruption sends ash to Negros and Cebu
record.detail: PHIVOLCS reported a 3-minute moderately explosive eruption with 2-3 km plume; ashfall in Canlaon, San Carlos and parts of Cebu; Alert Level 2.

record.title: Pangasinan tightens poultry checks after bird flu
record.detail: Avian influenza cases confirmed in June in two Pangasinan towns prompted a ban on live poultry from affected areas and stricter checkpoint inspections requiring veterinary health certificates, according to local officials and the Bureau of Animal Industry.
record.agency: Bureau of Animal Industry / Pangasinan LGUs
record.attribution: Local officials via GMA Regional TV

record.title: DOH-7 warns of Kanlaon ashfall risks in Cebu
record.detail: DOH Central Visayas Director Joshua Brillantes warned that ash from Kanlaon Volcano reaching Cebu, notably Toledo, could cause respiratory, skin and eye problems; EMB-7 detected elevated PM10. Residents were urged to stay indoors and wear N95/KN95 masks.

record.title: H5N1 bird flu in Oriental Mindoro backyard flock
record.detail: WOAH, citing Philippine authorities, reported an H5N1 outbreak in a backyard flock of 39 birds in Oriental Mindoro (town reported as 'Capalan'); all birds were culled.
record.agency: World Organisation for Animal Health (citing PH authorities)
record.attribution: WOAH report via Reuters/The Poultry Site

record.title: Typhoon Inday and enhanced monsoon: 20 reported dead
record.detail: NDRRMC reported 20 dead (1 validated), 9 injured and 16 missing from Typhoon Inday and the enhanced southwest monsoon; about 654,000 people affected and infrastructure damage estimated at PHP3.18 billion.
record.place: Mindanao and Visayas (Sarangani, Lanao del Sur, Bukidnon, Iloilo, Davao Occidental, Quezon)

record.title: AMLC seeks power to freeze assets without court order
record.detail: AMLC asked Congress for authority to suspend transactions and initially freeze assets without a CA order and to cover virtual asset providers and trusts, ahead of 2027 FATF evaluation.
record.attribution: AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura via Philstar

record.title: Navy sailor struck with baton near Ayungin Shoal
record.detail: AFP said a China Coast Guard member hit a Philippine Navy sailor on the head with a baton near BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin (Second Thomas) Shoal, also damaging a Philippine boat.
record.attribution: AFP, NSC and DND via Philstar

record.title: China Coast Guard water cannon at Scarborough Shoal (two days)
record.detail: PCG said China Coast Guard vessels fired water cannon at Philippine government vessels near Scarborough Shoal on 23 and 24 July, hitting two ships; China's foreign ministry called its actions lawful.
record.attribution: PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela via Al Jazeera

record.title: TD Kiyapo prompts Signal No. 1 in northern Luzon
record.detail: PAGASA raised Signal No. 1 over Batanes, Cagayan, Isabela and other northern Luzon areas; Kiyapo forecast to near or hit Babuyan/Cagayan.

record.title: Angat Dam hits lowest recorded level
record.detail: Angat Dam fell to 150.55 m, prompting MWSS to cut raw water allocation to Bulacan water districts.

record.title: 2 NPA killed, 1 captured in Oriental Mindoro
record.detail: Daily Tribune reported 2 NPA members killed and 1 captured in a clash in Oriental Mindoro (details limited).

record.title: Maymay rains trigger deadly landslides in Benguet and Rizal
record.detail: Reports said a hillside collapsed on a Benguet eatery killing two workers, and a landslide in Rizal killed two, amid TD Maymay (Kujira) rains.
record.attribution: Police and disaster agency via Philstar

record.title: Drilling-capable Chinese survey ship 25 days in PH EEZ
record.detail: PCG spokesperson Jay Tarriela said the Chinese survey ship Haiyang Dizhi Shihao operated in the Philippine EEZ from Aug 10 to Sept 4, including three weeks within Scarborough Shoal's territorial sea, without a DFA research permit and periodically with AIS off.

record.title: BARMM interim Chief Minister survives ambush
record.detail: Unidentified gunmen fired on the convoy of interim BARMM Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua; no casualties, vehicles damaged, ahead of 14 Sept elections.

record.title: Three gun attacks in BARMM kill 3
record.detail: Police reported three motorcycle-borne gun attacks on 21-22 Aug in Datu Odin Sinsuat, Pikit/Pagalungan area and Sultan Kudarat killing two women and a police-station civilian staffer; 2 wounded.
record.place: Datu Odin Sinsuat; Pikit/Pagalungan; Sultan Kudarat

record.title: Pasay residential fire kills family of 4
record.detail: A second-alarm fire on Tengco Street, Barangay 107, killed four members of one family trapped when their house collapsed, injured at least four and affected about 30 families, per BFP and barangay officials.
record.attribution: BFP and barangay officials via Philstar

record.title: Red tide warning for Leyte, Leyte shellfish
record.detail: BFAR issued a precautionary shellfish warning for coastal waters of Leyte town after samples tested positive for paralytic shellfish toxin, pending confirmation; bans also remained in Matarinao Bay and Biliran Island waters.
record.agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources

record.title: Motorbanca capsizes on Lake Mapanuepe, 6 Aeta dead
record.detail: PCG said a boat carrying 13 Aeta residents capsized in strong winds; 6 dead incl. 3 minors, 3 missing, 4 rescued.

record.title: Tarlac bridges collapse in monsoon floods; 4 missing
record.detail: DPWH said river currents washed out a pier of Agana Bridge after Aquino Bridge partly collapsed on 28 Aug; a vehicle fell in, 4 missing, 1 rescued; province declared state of calamity.
record.attribution: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon via Philstar

record.title: Monsoon backflood inundates 71 Bulacan villages
record.detail: Bulacan PDRRMO said floods up to five feet hit Calumpit; 71 villages in six towns flooded, 5,511 people in evacuation centres.

record.title: OCD: August floods and landslides kill over 30 in Luzon
record.detail: OCD said monsoon rains enhanced by Luis, Maymay, Neneng and Obet killed 30+, incl. 15 in Benguet mostly from landslides; about 8 million affected.

record.title: Storms Maymay, Luis, Neneng and habagat: 33 dead, 8.6M affected
record.detail: NDRRMC figures reported 33 dead, 19 injured and 3 missing, with 8.6 million people affected across Luzon, Visayas and Western Mindanao; infrastructure damage PHP6.12 billion and farm losses PHP2.32 billion; 117 LGUs under state of calamity.

record.title: DOH issues air quality guidance amid haze
record.detail: DOH issued an air quality index guide and advised masks and limited outdoor activity as haze, linked to Indonesian fires, reportedly pushed readings to 'very unhealthy' in parts of Bicol and Zamboanga Peninsula; Metro Manila stayed fair to good, per DENR-EMB and UP IESM data cited.

record.title: Leptospirosis: 6,253 cases, 378 deaths; post-flood surge warned
record.detail: DOH reported 6,253 leptospirosis cases and 378 deaths (CFR 6.05%) from Jan 4 to Aug 29, 2026, and warned of a post-flood surge; several Quezon City and Manila hospitals were near full capacity. Quezon City logged 437 cases and 30 deaths, 296 cases in August alone.

record.title: PLA flares fired at PCG aircraft over Kalayaan Island Group
record.detail: PCG said flares were fired from Zamora (Subi) and Panganiban (Mischief) reefs at an unarmed PCG maritime domain awareness flight.
record.attribution: PCG spokesperson Rear Adm. Jay Tarriela via PNA

record.title: MV June Aster ferry fire off Coron: 77 dead
record.detail: PCG said the Manila-Coron ferry caught fire off Coron; toll reached 77 dead, 12 missing, 43 rescued by 16 Sept; cause under investigation.

record.title: Two police among 5 held in PNPA recruitment extortion
record.detail: CIDG arrested five, including two police officers, for demanding PHP250,000 (later PHP150,000) from a police academy applicant.

record.title: Election-day gun violence in Cotabato City
record.detail: Philstar reported gun violence before polls opened in Cotabato City left 3 dead and 15 wounded during the first BARMM parliamentary elections; Comelec called incidents isolated.

record.title: 8 Metro Manila DOH hospitals full for leptospirosis
record.detail: DOH said eight Metro Manila hospitals including East Avenue Medical Center, Quirino Memorial and Tondo Medical Center had filled their leptospirosis bed capacity, with San Lazaro Hospital holding 86 cases; 128 beds remained in 12 other DOH hospitals. It cited 8,317 infections nationwide in 2026.

record.title: China Coast Guard rams BFAR vessel off Palawan
record.detail: PCG said China Coast Guard cutter 21585 deliberately rammed BFAR vessel Magat Salamat about 54 nm off Palawan on a mission to support a grounded vessel near Half Moon Shoal, damaging railings; China's coast guard blamed the Philippine side.
record.place: Off Palawan (about 54 nm), West Philippine Sea
record.attribution: PCG and China Coast Guard statements via USNI News

record.title: 1-2 cyclones a month expected Oct-Dec
record.detail: PAGASA expects one to two tropical cyclones per month in Q4 2026, mostly landfalling or crossing, amid strong El Nino.

record.title: Leptospirosis up 38%, dengue down 33%
record.detail: DOH reported 10,936 suspected leptospirosis cases as of Sept 16 (up 38% year on year), driven by typhoon and monsoon floods, with NCR, Cagayan Valley and Calabarzon most affected. Dengue cases fell 33% to 155,918 from Jan 4 to Sept 16.

record.title: AMLC: PHP24.7B frozen, mostly flood-control corruption
record.detail: AMLC reported PHP24.7 billion in assets frozen; 14 flood-control cases cover about PHP20.2 billion, and 18 of 28 civil forfeiture petitions in Jan-Jun 2026 were corruption-linked (PHP15.7 billion).

record.title: Report estimates PHP603B yearly exposure to mule-driven fraud
record.detail: A private-sector report (IDfy Philippines and CIBI) estimated PHP603 billion a year at risk from mule-account fraud; NBI cited mule accounts selling for PHP500-5,000 each.
record.attribution: IDfy Philippines and CIBI report via Philstar

record.title: PAGASA: very strong El Nino from October
record.detail: PAGASA forecast a very strong El Nino from October 2026 with below to way-below-normal rain in Luzon, Visayas, Caraga; about 45 provinces already had rainfall deficits.

record.title: Bus plunges into ravine in fog near Talagang; 5 dead, 27 hurt
record.detail: A Rawalpindi-Multan bus lost control on a foggy mountain road near Dhok Pathan and fell about 100 feet into a ravine; Rescue 1122 reported 5 dead and 27 injured. Motorways M-1 to M-5 and M-14 were closed for fog, diverting traffic to GT Road.

record.title: BLA coordinated attacks across Quetta and nine Balochistan districts
record.detail: BLA claimed coordinated attacks on military, police and government sites in Quetta and nine districts; Al Jazeera reported 15 security personnel and 18 civilians killed, and officials claimed 92 BLA fighters killed in 48 hours. Train and internet services were suspended.
record.attribution: Toll per officials cited by Al Jazeera; militant toll is a government claim; BLA claimed responsibility

record.title: Gul Plaza mall fire in Karachi kills at least 28
record.detail: A mid-January night fire at Karachi's Gul Plaza shopping mall killed at least 28; firefighters told a commissioner-led inquiry that locked grill doors and blocked stairways trapped occupants. The cause was still under investigation.

record.title: Suicide bombing at Islamabad mosque during Friday prayers
record.detail: A bombing at Khadija Al-Kubra mosque on the outskirts of Islamabad during Friday prayers killed at least 31 and wounded 169; there was no immediate claim.
record.attribution: Toll per officials cited by Euronews

record.title: Pakistan launches Operation Ghazab lil Haq against Afghan Taliban
record.detail: Pakistan's military launched Operation Ghazab lil Haq late on 26 February after renewed cross-border clashes. By 7 March Information Minister Attaullah Tarar claimed 527 Afghan Taliban killed, 755 injured, 237 posts destroyed and 38 captured; figures not independently verified.
record.attribution: Casualty figures are claims by Information Minister Attaullah Tarar, reported by The Express Tribune (7 Mar 2026)

record.title: Pro-Iran protesters storm US consulate Karachi; deadly unrest
record.detail: After the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader in US-Israeli strikes, protesters tried to storm the US consulate in Karachi; at least 10 killed and over 70 wounded there, and 7 killed in Gilgit-Baltistan, with a UN office burned in Skardu.
record.attribution: Tolls per officials/rescue services cited by Al Jazeera and AFP

record.title: Over 500 flights cancelled in three days over regional war
record.detail: Pakistan Airports Authority data showed over 500 domestic and international flights cancelled over three days at Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, Peshawar, Quetta, Faisalabad and Multan as Gulf airspaces closed.

record.title: Taftan trade disrupted, prices soar as Pakistanis flee Iran war
record.detail: Pakistanis were returning via Taftan after US-Israeli strikes on Iran; with the crossing's trade disrupted, local food and fuel prices reportedly doubled or tripled and PM Shehbaz Sharif ordered contingency measures.
record.attribution: Local accounts reported by Pakistan TV

record.title: Coast Guards and Navy seize $110m of drugs in Jiwani hills
record.detail: Pakistan Coast Guards and Navy seized 1,050 kg hashish and 200 kg methamphetamine hidden in the Jiwani mountains awaiting sea shipment, valued at about $110 million.

record.title: Navy launches Operation Muhafiz-ul-Bahr to protect shipping
record.detail: ISPR said the Pakistan Navy launched Operation Muhafiz-ul-Bahr to counter threats to national shipping and sea lines amid the Iran war; at launch Navy ships were escorting two merchant vessels with PNSC.

record.title: Emergency austerity as Iran war triggers fuel crisis
record.detail: PM Shehbaz Sharif ordered a four-day week for government staff, two-week school closures from 16 March and cuts in fuel use as Hormuz disruption hit oil supply; petrol rose about 20% in a week.

record.title: FIA-SBP joint working group formed against hawala-hundi
record.detail: Government formed an FIA-State Bank joint working group co-chaired by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb to act against illegal cross-border fund transfers.

record.title: 10,619 people return from Iran via Taftan since war began
record.detail: FIA said 10,619 passengers arrived at Taftan between 28 February and 8 April 2026 as the Iran war disrupted the region; FIA deployed round-the-clock immigration staff.
record.attribution: Figures from the Federal Investigation Agency

record.title: SBP lifts seven-year ban on banks serving licensed crypto firms
record.detail: State Bank allowed banks to open accounts for PVARA-licensed virtual asset providers while barring them from trading or holding crypto, with enhanced due diligence and AML/CFT monitoring required.
record.attribution: SBP circular as reported by CoinDesk

record.title: KP puts hospitals on high alert as mpox cases reach 26
record.detail: The KP Health Department ordered all hospitals to isolate suspected mpox cases and step up surveillance after 26 confirmed infections over 12 months, warning of local transmission.

record.title: FIA seizes over Rs250m at Chakdara in hawala raid
record.detail: FIA arrested two suspects at Chakdara toll plaza and recovered over Rs250 million allegedly moved via unlicensed hawala/hundi.

record.title: Suicide car bomb hits Quetta shuttle train at Chaman Phatak
record.detail: A vehicle-borne suicide bomb struck the Quetta Cantonment-railway station shuttle train near Chaman Phatak, derailing three coaches; Dawn's early report gave 14 dead (incl. 3 FC personnel) and 20 injured, later reports put the toll far higher. CM Sarfraz Bugti blamed 'Fitna al Hindustan'.
record.attribution: Early toll per officials cited by Dawn; BLA reportedly claimed

record.title: Police and peace committee kill 25 militants in Bannu clash
record.detail: Bannu's district police officer said more than 25 militants, including two commanders, were killed in fighting in Barakzai Akhundkhel, Miryan tehsil; two police and two civilians died and 10 were injured. A 10 kg remote-controlled bomb near a mosque was defused.

record.title: Power shortfall hits 6,500 MW; rural load-shedding up to 16 hours
record.detail: Express Tribune reported demand near 22,000 MW against 15,400 MW supply, with 3-8 hour urban and 8-16 hour rural outages; a Petroleum Division official blamed halted LNG cargoes, and the Power Division cited a 1,991 MW drop in hydropower.

record.title: Dadu hits record 51.5C as Sindh heatwave peaks
record.detail: PMD recorded 51.5C at Dadu, 4.5C above normal; Larkana and Jacobabad hit 50.5C, with 47-50C forecast across upper Sindh.

record.title: Bannu police repel pre-dawn assault on Mazanga post; 6 attackers killed
record.detail: Express Tribune reported police repelled an armed pre-dawn assault on the Mazanga police post early on a Wednesday, killing at least six attackers; one constable was lightly injured and weapons and grenades were recovered.

record.title: FBR designates Taftan railway station a land customs station
record.detail: FBR notification SRO1055/2026 designated the 11.75-acre Taftan railway station as a land customs station for Pakistan-Iran trade, aiming to curb informal trade channels.

record.title: Glacier melt floods hit Nagar, Ghanche, Ghizer; GLOF alert
record.detail: Heatwave-driven glacier melt flooded Hoper and Hisper valleys (Nagar), Ghanche and Ghizer, submerging a Hushe suspension bridge and briefly blocking the KKH near Khunjerab; NDMA issued a GLOF alert.

record.title: DG ISPR: 38 killed in three Balochistan attacks over four days
record.detail: DG ISPR Lt Gen Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry said attacks 4-8 July (Hanna Urak, Ziarat checkpoint, Bela-Winder convoy ambush) killed 4 civilians, 27 police and 7 soldiers, and claimed 54 militants killed; he alleged Indian backing and Afghan nationals among attackers.
record.attribution: Claims by DG ISPR reported by Dawn

record.title: FIA arrests suspect over families of Pakistanis missing in Iran
record.detail: FIA arrested a suspect in Gujrat allegedly in a network that took money from families of 12 Pakistanis missing in Iran with false promises of travel to Europe; another held for French work-visa fraud.

record.title: TTP-linked suicide vehicle attack on Tank check post kills 15
record.detail: ISPR said militants assaulted a joint police check post in Tank and detonated an explosive-laden vehicle overnight 23/24 July, killing 12 soldiers, 2 policemen and a forest official; ISPR claimed 12 attackers killed.
record.attribution: ISPR statement; militants described by ISPR as 'Fitna al Khawarij' (TTP)

record.title: Monsoon toll passes 100; Lahore-Gujranwala plains inundated
record.detail: NDMA said 107 killed and 344 injured since late June (KP 55, Punjab 36); about 400 sq km under water in Lahore and Gujranwala divisions and 17 relief camps set up in Lahore.
record.attribution: NDMA figures; cumulative national toll placed at Lahore

record.title: Quadcopter-and-gun attack on Hangu police post kills 11 officers
record.detail: Attackers used explosive-laden quadcopters before storming a police checkpoint in Hangu, killing 11 officers including a deputy superintendent and wounding 28; police said 15 attackers were killed. No claim.
record.attribution: Figures from District Police Officer Mujahid Hussain via Al Jazeera

record.title: Suicide bomber hits Kabal police station in Swat; 17 dead
record.detail: A suicide bomber blew himself up at the Kabal police station entrance as officers moved to search him, while a protest against lawlessness was under way nearby; 7 police and 10 civilians died and 27 were injured. No claim was reported.

record.title: NDMA warns heavy rain, hill torrents; toll 126
record.detail: NDMA warned of heavy to very heavy rain through 4 August with flash-flood risk in DG Khan hill torrents and urban flooding in Lahore, Rawalpindi, Gujranwala, Hyderabad; season toll 126 since 26 June.

record.title: 144 Karachi children dead from measles and diphtheria since January
record.detail: Hospital data reported by Dawn showed 1,915 measles cases with 125 deaths and 81 diphtheria cases with 19 deaths in Karachi in the first seven months of 2026; the Sindh EPI director said measles cases were down 35% on 2025.

record.title: GLOF and cloudburst cut off Chitral, two dead
record.detail: Glacial outburst and a cloudburst hit valleys across Upper and Lower Chitral, killing two, destroying about a dozen bridges in Karimabad, cutting the Chitral-Peshawar and Chitral-Shandur roads and internet; over 150 vehicles stranded.

record.title: 258 foreigners held in Islamabad scam call centre raid
record.detail: FIA detained 258 foreign nationals (about 40 Chinese, 170 Vietnamese, plus Malaysians and others) at a call centre in Gulberg Green allegedly running Ponzi/investment fraud; they had entered on tourist visas.
record.attribution: FIA figures reported by ProPakistani; raid 'last week' before 17 Aug

record.title: NCCIA raids 'Aofu Group' centre in I-10, 276 foreigners arrested
record.detail: NCCIA arrested 276 foreigners at an I-10/3 facility operating as 'Aofu Group', alleged to lure victims into sexual video chats, impersonation and cheating; FIR under PECA 2016.

record.title: Pakistan to blacklist 671 foreigners held in call centre raids
record.detail: FIA will blacklist 671 foreign nationals arrested in call centre raids and the government approved an FIA-led nationwide task force, with focus on Karachi; offences alleged include fraud, blackmail, gambling and live-streamed explicit content.
record.attribution: FIA decision reported by Daily Pakistan

record.title: Punjab load-shedding returns as national shortfall tops 4,000 MW
record.detail: Express Tribune reported a national shortfall over 4,000 MW and over 1,200 MW in LESCO's area, with Lahore residents facing hour-on, hour-off cuts after a failed RLNG cargo delivery reduced plant output.

record.title: FIA deports 20 more Chinese nationals in I-10 call centre case
record.detail: FIA deported 20 Chinese nationals linked to the I-10 call centre (34 deported in the case, incl. 14 Vietnamese earlier) and blacklisted them; charges under Foreigners Act and PECA.
record.attribution: FIA figures reported by The Nation

record.title: ANF-DEA seize 463kg crystal meth bound for Colombo
record.detail: ANF with US DEA and Sri Lanka police seized about 463 kg of crystal methamphetamine in containers to be shipped from Pakistan to Colombo, worth about $21 million (Rs5.8bn); several suspects arrested.
record.attribution: DEA/ANF statement reported by The Nation; exact seizure site not given

record.title: KP dengue cases reach 478 for 2026, led by Peshawar and Kohat
record.detail: The KP Health Department's disease surveillance system reported 478 confirmed dengue cases this year (83 in the past week) out of 2,697 suspected, with Peshawar 177 and Kohat 151; no deaths reported.

record.title: 150mm downpour floods Islamabad; Nullah Lai at dangerous level
record.detail: About 150 mm fell in Islamabad's E-11; Nullah Lai rose to dangerous levels and Rawalpindi declared a holiday. NDMA put the season toll (26 Jun-31 Aug) at 175 (KP 70, Punjab 61, Sindh 17).
record.attribution: Rainfall and toll per NDMA/PMD via Arab News

record.title: ANF seizes 364.6kg of narcotics worth Rs2.12bn in eight operations
record.detail: ANF reported eight operations incl. Peshawar airport, Sangjani toll plaza (52.8 kg hashish, 5.4 kg opium) and Lahore, seizing narcotics worth over Rs2.12 billion and arresting eight.

record.title: Fire collapses half of a Landhi EPZ factory in Karachi
record.detail: Rescue 1122 said a blaze at a used-clothing factory in the Landhi Export Processing Zone engulfed the building and caused about half of it to collapse, damaging an adjacent factory; 16 fire tenders responded and three workers had minor injuries.

record.title: Fourth polio case of 2026 confirmed in Bannu
record.detail: NEOC confirmed a wild poliovirus case in Nurar UC, Miryan tehsil, Bannu, bringing 2026 cases to four (KP 3, Sindh 1); three are from southern KP where security limits vaccinator access.

record.title: FIA probes alleged Rs172bn laundering by Islamabad call centre network
record.detail: FIA is investigating about Rs172 billion allegedly moved through bank and microfinance accounts and sent abroad by the call centre network; a nine-member JIT was formed and 50 Vietnamese detainees deported.
record.attribution: FIA allegations reported by Daily Pakistan

record.title: Car bomb and assault on Kohat Police Lines kill 23
record.detail: Attackers detonated a vehicle bomb near the police lines mosque during Friday prayers and stormed the compound; KP police said 17 police and 6 civilians died, over 100 were hurt and 8 attackers were killed in an overnight clearance. Hafiz Gul Bahadur's Ittehadul Mujahideen claimed it; later reports put the toll at 31.

record.title: Two officers among six soldiers killed in Hangu convoy ambush
record.detail: ISPR said a convoy came under attack in Hangu district, killing six soldiers including a captain and a lieutenant; ISPR claimed eight 'Fitna al-Khawarij' militants killed.

record.title: NCCIA raids three E-11/G-10 call centres, 212 held
record.detail: NCCIA raided three call centres in Islamabad's E-11 and G-10, detaining 212 including seven Chinese nationals, over Google-related, loan, dating and trading frauds; 306 phones and 383 computers seized, links alleged to networks in India and Brazil.

record.title: 217 scammers and money mules investigated

record.title: Exercise SG Ready 2026 simulates prolonged power and digital outages

record.title: PUB flash-flood risk warning in Jurong/Boon Lay
record.detail: PUB warned at 15:32 of flash-flood risk along Jalan Boon Lay (International Rd to Enterprise Rd) and at Yuan Ching Rd/Yung Kuang Rd, advising the public to avoid the area for an hour amid heavy rain.

record.title: CNB islandwide operation: 99 arrested
record.detail: CNB said a 2-6 Feb islandwide operation covering Ang Mo Kio, Choa Chu Kang, Jurong, Marine Parade, Marsiling and Sembawang led to 99 arrests and seizures worth over S$38,000, including cannabis, heroin, Ice and etomidate vape pods.

record.title: CNB 2025 drug report: new abusers up 17%
record.detail: CNB reported 3,208 drug abusers arrested in 2025 (up 1%), with new abusers up 17% to 1,165, half under 30, and the youngest arrested aged 12; drugs seized were valued at about S$21.95 million.

record.title: Flash flood on Jurong Town Hall Road
record.detail: PUB reported a flash flood on Jurong Town Hall Road between Jurong East St 11 and 12 at about 17:55 on the second day of Chinese New Year, subsiding by about 6.16:00; MSS had warned of heavy thundery showers over the south, west and central areas.
record.attribution: PUB and MSS alerts via AsiaOne

record.title: S$350m more seized in Prince Group laundering probe
record.detail: SPF said three Singaporeans were arrested (Nov 2025-Jan 2026) for suspected money laundering linked to Prince Holding Group, founded by sanctioned tycoon Chen Zhi, and that about S$350 million in properties, vehicles, cash, accounts and luxury goods were newly seized or prohibited, taking the total to over S$500 million.

record.title: 12 Protection from Scams Act restriction orders issued
record.detail: MHA said in a written parliamentary reply that police had issued 12 restriction orders on at-risk scam victims' bank accounts as of 15 Feb 2026, with 9 still in effect.

record.title: Fund manager directors arrested; S$160m seized
record.detail: SPF and MAS said two directors of a licensed fund management company were arrested on suspicion of money laundering and more than S$160 million seized, after STRO intelligence; MAS cited serious AML control failings.

record.title: Three sea robberies on bulk carriers in Phillip Channel
record.detail: ReCAAP ISC reported three robberies on bulk carriers in the eastbound lane of the Phillip Channel TSS on 18-19 March, within 0.7-1.7 nm of each other; one crew member was injured and engine spares were stolen from one ship. It said all 10 incidents in the Straits since January were in the Singapore Strait.

record.title: Nominee director and company secretary charged over shell firms
record.detail: SPF said a 35-year-old resident director and a 36-year-old corporate service provider would be charged after two Singapore shell companies received about US$1.08 million and EUR 44,800 in overseas scam proceeds in 2023.

record.title: Warm dry spell forecast with 35-36C highs and haze risk
record.detail: NEA/MSS forecast daily highs of 35-36C in late March under dry northeast monsoon conditions and warned hotspots in Central Sumatra and Johor could raise haze risk; PSI was 45-57 on 20 March.

record.title: 35.4C recorded at Sembawang
record.detail: MSS said the second half of March was dry with sparse rain, with the highest temperature of 35.4C at Sembawang on 30 March; it forecast inter-monsoon thundery showers from early April.

record.title: Welder dies in confined pipe at Tuas shipyard
record.detail: MOM said a 24-year-old welder was found unconscious inside a 28-inch pipe on a vessel module at a Tuas South Boulevard shipyard and pronounced dead; it reminded employers of confined-space atmospheric testing and permit-to-work rules.

record.title: Singaporean deported from Cambodia to face scam charges
record.detail: SPF said a 29-year-old Singaporean was arrested on deportation from Cambodia for allegedly giving a scam syndicate access to bank accounts in 2021-2022.

record.title: Signalling fault halts all 27 Thomson-East Coast Line stations
record.detail: SMRT said a signalling fault after overnight tests stopped trains across the whole TEL from 08:14, with delays from 06:55; service fully resumed at 10:48 and free and bridging buses were deployed.
record.place: Thomson-East Coast Line (Woodlands North to Bayshore)

record.title: Member of Phnom Penh scam compound group repatriated
record.detail: SPF said a 30-year-old Singaporean arrested by Cambodian police was repatriated on 4 May over links to a Phnom Penh-based group running government-official impersonation scams tied to at least 535 cases and about S$53 million in losses; Interpol Red Notices were issued for two more suspects.

record.title: Worker killed by falling concrete slab at Cross Island Line site
record.detail: A 23-year-old banksman was struck and killed by a concrete slab during excavation at the Turf City MRT station worksite on Turf Club Road; MOM issued a stop-work order to the contractor joint venture and opened a joint investigation with police.
record.place: Turf City MRT station worksite, Turf Club Road

record.title: NEA: peak dengue season begins
record.detail: NEA said over 600 dengue cases were reported as of 15 May 2026, about 66% fewer than a year earlier, and urged vigilance as the May-October peak season began; Project Wolbachia is to cover about half of households by end-2026.

record.title: Operation FRONTIER+ III: 130+ arrests in Singapore
record.detail: SPF said the 10-territory Operation FRONTIER+ III (10 Mar-7 May) led to over 130 arrests in Singapore, 2,315 bank accounts frozen and S$34.9 million seized; regionally 3,018 were arrested over fraud totalling about US$752 million.
record.attribution: SPF figures via The Online Citizen

record.title: 295 scammers and money mules investigated
record.detail: SPF said a 7-20 May operation investigated 295 people aged 15-76 linked to over 751 scam cases with losses over S$5 million.

record.title: Southwest Monsoon onset; warm nights forecast
record.detail: MSS said the Southwest Monsoon was setting in during early June, with Sumatra squalls possible on several pre-dawn mornings, highs of 33-35C, nights often above 28C and below-average rain in the first half of June.

record.title: Supply boat sinks after collision off Pasir Panjang; 3 dead
record.detail: MPA said a supply boat collided with a landing craft off Pasir Panjang Terminal at about 09:30 and sank; the PCG recovered three bodies believed to be its crew. Port operations were not disrupted.
record.agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

record.title: Dengue cases hit 2026 weekly high of 119
record.detail: NEA reported 119 dengue cases in the week to 13 June, up 39 from the week before and the highest weekly count of 2026, with 12 active clusters including four red-alert clusters.

record.title: First transnational etomidate vape pod syndicate busted
record.detail: HSA said it arrested four Singaporean men in raids on flats in Teck Whye and Tampines, seizing 1,111 etomidate vape pods (street value over S$83,000) and cash; it linked the group to a May importation case at Woodlands Checkpoint involving pods worth over S$800,000.

record.title: ISA orders on two Singaporeans radicalised by pro-Hamas narratives
record.detail: ISD said a 30-year-old was detained under the ISA after seeking to join Hamas and indicating willingness to conduct attacks if instructed, and a 19-year-old was issued a Restriction Order for online posts inciting violence under composite violent extremist beliefs.

record.title: Singapore-flagged Ever Lovely hit by projectile in Hormuz
record.detail: MPA said the Singapore-registered container ship Ever Lovely sustained minor bridge damage from an unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz; all 21 crew were safe. MPA called the strike unprovoked and a breach of international law.
record.agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

record.title: MOT on recourse for Hormuz projectile strike
record.detail: The Transport Ministry said the Ever Lovely's managers may pursue war-risk or marine insurance claims and reiterated Singapore's position on the right of transit passage under UNCLOS.

record.title: Singapore Strait sea robberies down 74% in H1
record.detail: ReCAAP ISC counted 21 robbery incidents in the Singapore Strait in H1 2026 versus 80 a year earlier; its executive director credited industry preventive measures and law-enforcement responses by littoral states.

record.title: Three youths aged 14-19 detained under ISA over attack plans
record.detail: ISD said three self-radicalised male youths (14, 15 and 19) were detained between April and June 2026 after making concrete preparations for attacks, including a planned school stabbing and pressure-cooker bombs; ISD said the 14-year-old is the youngest person ever detained under the ISA.

record.title: Over 5kg of cannabis seized in three raids
record.detail: CNB said raids at Ang Mo Kio Ave 4, Pasir Ris St 11 and Jalan Bukit Ho Swee netted three Singaporean men and about 5.5kg of cannabis plus Ice, ketamine and LSD, worth over S$142,000.
record.place: Ang Mo Kio, Pasir Ris, Bukit Ho Swee

record.title: Clementi HDB flat fire kills one, injures two firefighters
record.detail: SCDF said a fire in an 8th-floor unit at Block 309 Clementi Avenue 4 around 23:10 left one occupant dead in hospital and two firefighters with burns; about 40 residents were evacuated. Cause under investigation.

record.title: Scams (Countermeasures) Bill tabled
record.detail: MHA tabled a bill letting police disable accounts, restrict suspected mules' access to banking, telco and Singpass services for up to 3 years, criminalise supplying online accounts, and raise platform penalties to S$10 million per breach; tech outlets reported it passed on 9 Sept.

record.title: 2,428 caught vaping in Q2; nine charged over etomidate
record.detail: HSA and MOH said 2,428 people were caught for vape possession or use from April to June 2026 (457 involving etomidate pods), over 3,900 vaporisers were seized at checkpoints and nine people were charged for importing or supplying etomidate vapes.

record.title: 270 scammers and money mules investigated
record.detail: SPF said a 30 Jul-12 Aug operation by Cyber Command and all seven land divisions investigated 270 people aged 15-80 linked to more than 660 scam cases with losses of about S$5.4 million.

record.title: H1 scam cases fall 17.9%; losses S$410.6m
record.detail: SPF reported 18,391 scam and cybercrime cases in H1 2026 (down from 22,397) with losses of S$410.6 million (from S$500.2 million); investment scams caused the largest losses and the Anti-Scam Centre recovered over S$97.7 million.
record.attribution: SPF mid-year brief via Malay Mail

record.title: 24-hr PSI enters Unhealthy range for first time since 2023
record.detail: NEA said the 24-hr PSI in the central region entered the Unhealthy range (above 100) at 07:00 on 4 Sept, the first time since Oct 2023, and activated haze measures including air purifiers in schools and healthcare facilities and daily haze advisories.

record.title: RSN-PLA Navy Exercise Maritime Cooperation 2026
record.detail: MINDEF said frigate RSS Steadfast joined the PLA Navy's PLANS Dali for the fifth Exercise Maritime Cooperation off Zhanjiang, China, 5-9 Sept, including gunnery, manoeuvring and SAR drills.

record.title: Auctions of assets forfeited in S$3b laundering case begin
record.detail: Deloitte, appointed by SPF, said public auctions of over 80 properties and 1,000+ luxury items forfeited in the 2023 S$3 billion money-laundering case would run from 7 Sept 2026 into mid-2027.

record.title: Haze eases to Moderate; smoke plumes persist
record.detail: MSS said 24-hr PSI was 74-97 (Moderate) at 17:00 on 9 Sept, with smoke plumes still detected from fires in southern and central Sumatra and Kalimantan, and forecast High Moderate to Low Unhealthy levels.

record.title: ISD threat assessment: self-radicalised youth surge
record.detail: ISD's 2026 Terrorism Threat Assessment said eight people were dealt with under the ISA since July 2025, six of them under 21, and that youth cases rose from 4 (2017-2021) to 15 since 2022; it also flagged first cases of composite violent extremism.

record.title: MSS forecasts haze to worsen to mid-Unhealthy
record.detail: MSS said 24-hr PSI was 88-117 at 17:00 on 14 Sept as east-southeasterly winds carried smoke from fires in Kalimantan and southern Sumatra, and forecast the 24-hr PSI in the High Moderate to Mid Unhealthy range.

record.title: Bulk carrier collides with Chinese fishing vessel in Singapore Strait
record.detail: MPA said Panama-registered bulker First Margaux collided with a China-registered fishing vessel, which took on water but stayed afloat and was towed to Raffles Reserved Anchorage; no injuries, pollution or traffic impact reported.
record.agency: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore

record.prov: Nghe An / Ha Tinh / Son La

record.title: Repeated night blackouts in Hanoi as heatwave drives record demand

record.agency: EVN Hanoi / Ba Dinh Power Company

record.title: Police seize 23 kg of heroin and meth near Lao border; officer slashed

record.attribution: Provincial police via Viet Nam News

record.title: Vietnam, China, Laos, Myanmar launch joint anti-drug crackdown

record.title: Over 400 arrested in MPS operation 126N drug crackdown

record.title: AMLO board moves to confiscate about 13bn baht from Cambodia-linked scam networks
record.detail: AMLO's transaction board directed prosecutors to seek court confiscation of roughly 13 billion baht in land, condos, a yacht and deposits linked to the Yim Leak/Ben Smith network, sanctioned Prince Group chairman Chen Zhi, and Cambodian senator Kok An, Thai PBS World reported.

record.title: Bank of Thailand requires banks to question cash transactions of 5m baht or more
record.detail: The BoT said banks must ask the purpose of cash movements of 5 million baht or more and apply enhanced due diligence to curb 'grey capital', with a lower 3 million baht threshold under consideration.

record.title: Civil Court orders temporary seizure of 13.074bn baht in four scam cases
record.detail: The Civil Court issued temporary seizure orders on assets worth about 13.074 billion baht sought by AMLO in four cases, including about 12.1 billion baht in the Yim Leak/Ben Smith case, 560 million in the Kok An case and 345 million in the Chen Zhi case.

record.title: CIB obtains arrest warrants for 'Ben Smith' and wife over cross-border investment fraud
record.detail: The Central Investigation Bureau obtained warrants for Ben Smith, also identified as Benjamin Mauerberger, and his wife, citing evidence of cross-border investment fraud, while AMLO pursues money-laundering asset freezes, The Nation reported.

record.title: 93 Vietnamese held at Bangkok condo running gambling operation with 100m-baht daily flow
record.detail: Makkasan police detained 93 Vietnamese nationals at an Asoke-Rama 9 area condominium allegedly operating an online gambling platform for Vietnamese customers with over 100 million baht in daily cash flow, with money moved through banks in Vietnam, The Nation reported.

record.title: DSI secures 25 warrants in expanded gambling and laundering case linked to an MP
record.detail: DSI obtained 25 arrest warrants and searched 10 sites (5 in Songkhla, plus Pathum Thani, Nonthaburi and Bangkok) in an online gambling network case where about 1 billion baht circulated; about 39 million baht was allegedly linked to a sitting MP and some 150 million baht in assets was under AMLO consideration.

record.title: SEC proposes crypto 'Travel Rule' with AMLO to curb laundering
record.detail: The SEC proposed rules requiring digital asset operators to transmit sender and recipient data with transfers, keep records five years, and reject or freeze transfers lacking information, developed with AMLO; consultation ran to 25 March.

record.title: AMLO freezes further 8.27bn baht in Yim Leak-Ben Smith network probe
record.detail: AMLO froze an additional 8.27 billion baht in 34 items, including vehicles, loan receivables, deposits and securities, bringing the total in the case to 20.392 billion baht across 102 items, Khaosod English reported.

record.title: SEC reports 53,715 suspicious securities-linked accounts frozen
record.detail: The SEC said 53,715 suspicious mule accounts were frozen as of 28 February 2026, up from 47,692 at end-2025, and it collected 1.135 billion baht in civil sanctions and restitution in Q1 2026.

record.title: DSI forwards indictment of 11 in 'Thanthai' piracy, gambling and laundering network
record.detail: DSI forwarded an indictment against 11 suspects (4 arrested, 7 at large) in the 'Thanthai' group, accused of running pirate film sites carrying gambling ads and laundering money via mule accounts and digital asset trading; DSI cited over 4.5 billion baht in damages and more than 10 billion baht circulated.

record.title: Commerce ministry says high-risk nominee registrations fell 75%
record.detail: The Department of Business Development said high-risk company registrations fell 75% in 1-23 April versus a year earlier after stricter checks from 1 January, with 11 cases involving 300+ entities referred to the CIB and 4,372 foreign businesses possibly operating without permits.

record.title: DSI arrests alleged dummy-account operator for online casino group, 500m baht frozen
record.detail: In 'Operation Dragon's Scales', DSI arrested a man at a Chom Thong factory accused of opening dummy accounts to launder online casino funds and seized or froze about 500 million baht, with further gambling-den raids in Nakhon Ratchasima and Bangkok, CasinoBeats reported.

record.title: New AMLO Board rule on custody of seized digital assets takes effect
record.detail: An Anti-Money Laundering Board regulation effective 2 May requires seized digital assets held abroad to move to a licensed Thai operator or AMLO's cold wallet, with custody costs deducted from the assets, according to law firm Tilleke & Gibbins.

record.title: Government targets 50,000 suspect firms in tourist-resort nominee crackdown
record.detail: The Department of Business Development said it was targeting over 50,000 suspect companies in Phuket, Pattaya, Koh Samui, Hua Hin and Koh Phangan, following a 13 May Koh Phangan raid; penalties include fines of 300,000-1,000,000 baht and up to three years' prison.

record.title: Koh Phangan nominee sweep: 22 foreigners arrested, 200m baht in land seized
record.detail: A second-phase police sweep on Koh Phangan arrested 22 foreigners and seized 45 land plots worth over 200 million baht under the Foreign Business Act and Land Code, including plots of a yoga business allegedly controlled by a foreigner through Thai nominees, Thai Examiner reported.
record.attribution: Royal Thai Police, as reported by Thai Examiner

record.title: BoT to require source-of-funds declaration for cash deposits of 5m baht+
record.detail: The Bank of Thailand said depositors of 5 million baht or more in cash, and high-value banknote exchanges, will have to explain the source of funds, following an April withdrawal rule that cut high-value cash withdrawals by 25-30%.

record.title: DBD flags 53 Huai Khwang firms as nominee risks, refers to AMLO
record.detail: The Department of Business Development identified 53 high-risk companies in Huai Khwang, mostly with Chinese shareholders structured under 50% foreign ownership, and forwarded data to AMLO; some shareholders and accountants reportedly appeared on an AMLO watchlist.

record.title: House panel presses SEC over broker loophole in 59m-baht mule-account case
record.detail: A House anti-money-laundering committee questioned the SEC and a securities brokerage after victims' funds were routed via mule accounts into a trading platform, with nearly 59 million baht lost by 393 victims, The Nation reported.
record.agency: House Committee on Money Laundering / SEC

record.title: Government reports sharp fall in mule accounts under scam crackdown
record.detail: The government said about 189,887 personal and 10,672 corporate mule accounts were uncovered from October 2025 to May 2026, with personal mule accounts down 76.9% and 20.392 billion baht in syndicate assets seized.
record.agency: Technology and Transnational Crime Steering Committee

record.title: DSI widens probe into Chinese-capital network behind illegal crypto mining
record.detail: DSI expanded its investigation of illegal crypto mining networks, which allegedly caused over 953 million baht in electricity losses and moved over 10 billion baht a year, into suspected transnational laundering; eight warrants were issued and seven more sought, The Nation reported.

record.title: AMLO auctions seized superyacht from Ben Smith case in Phuket
record.detail: AMLO scheduled an auction at Phuket Provincial Hall of the 51-metre yacht ATLAS (starting bid 600 million baht) and support vessel STRIDER (8.1 million baht), seized in the Yim Leak/Ben Smith scam and laundering case.

record.title: CIB busts unlicensed baht-yuan exchange and remittance service
record.detail: The Economic Crime Suppression Division arrested a Chinese man and a Thai woman in Chom Thong for running an unlicensed baht-to-yuan exchange and online transfer service handling over 26 million baht in six months, over 1.1 million baht of it linked to tech-crime cases.

record.title: BoT targets grey capital via cash deposits, gold withdrawals and USDT flows
record.detail: The Bank of Thailand said it will require source-of-funds checks on cash deposits of 5 million baht or more from Q4 2026, flag suspicious gold trades, and run joint audits with the SEC on high-volume USDT transactions.

record.title: Cyber police arrest 12 in 10bn-baht gambling and laundering network
record.detail: The Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau arrested 12 of 15 suspects in raids in Samut Prakan, Bangkok and Mae Sot, Tak, over an online gambling network with annual turnover of over 10 billion baht and about 500 million baht a month converted to crypto; over 13 million baht in assets was seized or frozen.

record.title: Police and AMLO hit gambling mule accounts, 4,500 sites shut during World Cup
record.detail: Police and AMLO said over 4,500 gambling websites were shut during the World Cup period and thousands of mule accounts targeted under a 'three-cut' strategy against sites, money flows and promoters, The Pattaya News reported.

record.title: Ombudsman proposes making nominee shareholding a money-laundering predicate
record.detail: The Ombudsman's Office proposed classifying nominee shareholding offences as predicate offences, which would let AMLO trace and seize assets; the idea is a recommendation, not enacted policy, Thai Examiner reported.

record.title: Vietnamese-led scam network laundered proceeds through gold bars
record.detail: Cyber police said a Vietnamese-led gang posing as a utility company defrauded 18 Thai victims of over 12 million baht, bought gold at legitimate shops and resold it for cash; five suspects were detained and gold bars worth 1.7 million baht seized, ASEAN NOW reported.

record.title: BoT caps youth digital transfers after 70% rise in youth mule accounts
record.detail: The BoT said daily transfer limits of 3,000-10,000 baht by age will apply to under-18 accounts from September (banks) and October (e-money), after youth mule accounts rose 70.3% with losses over 185 million baht.

record.title: Phuket raids target firms using naturalised citizens as possible nominee fronts
record.detail: Raids on 6 August led to 16 prosecutions and scrutiny of over 100 Phuket firms with about 5 billion baht in combined revenue suspected of using naturalised citizens as fronts, Thai Examiner reported.
record.attribution: Thai authorities, as reported by Thai Examiner

record.title: Vietnamese suspects held for converting scam proceeds into gold for transfer to Vietnam
record.detail: Metropolitan police arrested four Vietnamese in Bueng Kum over a network that turned fraud proceeds into gold bars, jewellery and phones for couriering to Vietnam, and over an attempted 150,000-baht bribe.

record.title: Attorney-General drops laundering case against investment group CEO
record.detail: The Attorney-General issued a final non-prosecution order for six suspects, including an investment holding group's CEO, in a DSI case alleging a pirated-film site, money laundering and gambling links with over 4.5 billion baht in damages; DSI withdrew arrest warrants.

record.title: Chinese man accused of running scam laundering network arrested in Pattaya
